summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for OTEC passwordless learning platform. 25/25 pytest backend tests passed covering OTP auth, user CRUD, self-registration auto-enroll, CSV import, course/module creation, sequential module locking, module quiz submission, final exam, diploma issuance + public verification, submissions AI analysis (Claude), live classes with status transitions, analytics, settings (incl. PNG signature validation), and role guards. Frontend UI OTP login flow (admin) verified end-to-end; all 7 staff pages load without visible errors; public /verificar/{code} shows 'Diploma verificado' for valid code and 'Diploma no válido' for invalid.

minor.issue: Emergent email proxy (Resend) returns 429 rate limit when many OTP requests happen in a short burst; backend correctly surfaces 502 'No se pudo enviar el correo'. Added retry/backoff in tests. Consider surfacing a 429 instead of 502 and queuing retries.

design_issues.screen: Dashboard main area immediately after login
issues: Appeared mostly blank in a captured screenshot (likely in-flight data load); consider skeletons for data widgets so first paint isn't empty.

action_items: No functional fixes required. Optional: surface upstream email provider 429 as 429 (not 502) so clients can retry.
Optional UX: add skeleton/empty-state on Dashboard while data loads.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 812 lines; could be split by domain (auth, courses, submissions, live, analytics) for maintainability.
auto_enroll iterates courses sequentially; fine at small scale but add index on {auto_enroll:1,published:1} if catalog grows.
verify-code mixes tz-naive/aware datetimes with workaround; prefer always storing timezone-aware ISO strings consistently.
Diploma `code` uses secrets.token_hex(6).upper() -> 12 hex chars; low collision risk but no retry on unique violation; acceptable.
require_enrollment + accessible_module re-fetch modules on every quiz load; cache if needed.
test_credentials: Admin UI/API: delivered+admin@resend.dev (id test-admin-1, role admin). OTP read from mongo db.otp_codes.code. Alternative: mint JWT with JWT_SECRET from backend/.env for created users.
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates: 1 course 'TEST_Curso1' (auto_enroll), 2 modules, final exam, ~8 TEST_* students, 3+ submissions, 2 live classes, settings with TEST_OTEC/TEST_Rector/TEST_Vice names, 1 diploma. Users emails are delivered+<label>@resend.dev. Please clean up as instructed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs 25 tests in ~90s. Run with: pytest -n 0 backend/tests/backend_test.py (serial is required because pytest-xdist loadscope caused multiple session-scoped admin logins to hit email rate limit). The suite uses OTP email only for 3 tests (TestAuth two cases + TestUsers.test_self_register_auto_enroll); all others mint JWT directly via JWT_SECRET env (default is the hardcoded fallback matching backend/.env). If Resend account hits a rate-limit window the OTP tests retry 4x with 45s backoff and finally pytest.skip. Diploma verification URL pattern: /verificar/{code}. Admin seeded users: ed0.2580@gmail.com and delivered+admin@resend.dev (test-admin-1).
